title: Understanding Communication Failures in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.32060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems aim to improve reasoning through debate, evidence sharing, and mutual correction, but interaction can also introduce failures that final accuracy alone cannot explain. Agents may converge too early, ignore dissent, suppress correct minority answers, or preserve a wrong framing across rounds. We present a corpus-grounded taxonomy of communication failures, built from 3,211 failed multi-round trajectories across medical QA, coding, finance, multi-hop reasoning, ethics, and embodied text tasks. Using this taxonomy, we analyze failure distributions across datasets and system designs, round-level error dynamics, recovery hardness, majority transitions, minority-signal suppression, and self-reported confidence. We find that failures are dominated by recovery/correction and consensus/decision problems rather than isolated first-round mistakes, with many emerging after agents first observe peer responses. translated_title: 理解多智能体大语言模型系统中的通信失败
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统旨在通过辩论、证据共享和相互纠正来提升推理能力，但智能体间的交互也可能引入仅凭最终准确率无法解释的失败。智能体可能过早达成一致、忽视异议、压制正确的少数派答案，或在多轮交互中保留错误的任务框架。我们提出了一个基于语料库的通信失败分类法，该分类法基于3,211条失败的多轮轨迹构建，涵盖医学问答、编程、金融、多跳推理、伦理和具身文本等任务。利用这一分类法，我们分析了失败在不同数据集和系统设计中的分布、轮次级的错误动态、恢复难度、多数派转变、少数派信号抑制以及智能体自我报告的置信度。我们发现，失败主要由恢复/纠正问题和共识/决策问题主导，而非孤立的首轮错误，且许多失败是在智能体首次观察到同伴响应之后才出现的。基于这些发
tldr: 该论文基于3,211条失败的多轮智能体交互轨迹，构建了多智能体LLM系统通信失败的分类法，并揭示失败主要由恢复/纠正与共识/决策问题主导，而非孤立的首轮错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a corpus-grounded taxonomy of communication failures in multi-agent LLM systems built from 3,211 failed trajectories, revealing that failures are dominated by recovery/correction and consensus/decision problems rather than isolated first-round mistakes.
